name: outputs-pane
description: Side pane listing files Claude writes or edits, split into planning, code and scratch, with a filter; click one to open it in your editor, or in a viewer split when you're in Rex on another machine

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: Command that opens a clicked file; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. zed, code -r, subl, /usr/local/bin/zed)

scratch.title: Scratch patterns
scratch.description: File names that go in the folded scratch section: comma-separated globs, * and ? as wildcards (e.g. msg-*, *.log); blank for none

markdownViewer.title: Remote markdown viewer
markdownViewer.description: In Rex on another machine, command that shows a clicked planning file in a split; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. glow -p, mdcat --paging)

codeViewer.title: Remote code viewer
codeViewer.description: In Rex on another machine, command that shows a clicked code file in a split; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. bat --paging=always, nvim -R)
